description: DIFC representative office of International Investment Bank Limited (head office in the Bahamas), DFSA-licensed 26-Sep-2024 (ref F009345). Restricted by licence to 'Operating a Representative Office' — marketing only, for the products/services of its Bahamas head office. Cannot itself hold client assets, manage portfolios or transact locally.

fit.disqualified_reason: Marketing-only DIFC representative office (restricted by DFSA licence to promoting its Bahamas head office's products); no local portfolio management, fund administration or client-money function that Gaia would serve. Record kept so we do not re-find and re-research it.
fit.reasoning: Fit and access rows barely apply: a representative office by definition does no portfolio management, fund administration or client-money holding of its own — all real operational decisions and systems sit with the Bahamas head office, not this DIFC shell. Regulated and in a priority market are the only rows with any substance.
